name: video-editor-web
description: Static web edition of Video Editör: the same editor, running entirely in the browser (WebCodecs + Mediabunny). The optional AI assistant runs a model in the browser itself on the graphics card (WebGPU, nothing to install: only the model files are downloaded), uses a cloud provider with the user's own key, Foundry Local on the user's own computer (through a small browser extension that the user installs), or a model server on the user's own computer that allows browsers (Ollama, LM Studio).
